$comment: Consumer half of the refs split (C3) for the tvOS app: per ref id in fiestaboard-design-refs (or a local stand-in), the kind and the Figma ids whose geometry/text the shot's FigmaGeometryRegistry probes are compared on. Ids are the 07b Screen-slot paths (I<instance>;149:182603;<child>). Waivers and tolerance overrides are added per entry with a Fable sign-off. Waivers apply per check, not per node, so DD8's interim card title ("FiestaBoard" vs the target "Maya’s FiestaPi") is left as a reported text finding rather than waived.
